 Serie A: Monza vs. Napoli – Probable line-ups and where to watch on TV 
 By Peter Young 
 Oct 28, 2026 10:09 
 NAPLES, ITALY - OCTOBER 24: Scott McTominay of SSC Napoli celebrates with Matteo Politano of SSC Napoli after scoring his team's second goal during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images) 
 Massimiliano Allegri is expected to make a series of changes to his Napoli starting line-up when the Partenopei take on Monza away from home in Serie A on Wednesday evening, which could include a change of goalkeepers.  
 A full round of Serie A fixtures is taking place this midweek, which got off to a flyer on Tuesday night with 18 goals scored across three fixtures for an average of six goals per game: Lazio beat 10-man Sassuolo 6-2 at the Mapei Stadium, Roma rose to a 4-2 victory over Cagliari at the Olimpico, while Cesc Fabregas and Como defeated Torino 3-1 at the Stadio Sinigaglia.  
 Monza and Napoli are in action at the Stadio Brianteo at 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET) on Wednesday evening.  
 MONZA, ITALY – APRIL 19: Luca Caldirola of Monza falls to the floor following him challenging Scott McTominay of Napoli during the Premier League match between Everton FC and Manchester City FC at Goodison Park on April 19, 2025 in Liverpool, England. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) The hosts have won two and lost two of their last four fixtures in Serie A, but are coming in off the back of a 3-2 defeat against Torino over the weekend.  
 Napoli, meanwhile, drew 3-3 at home against the in-form Roma on Saturday, which came after an all-action 4-3 victory over Bodo/Glimt in the Champions League last week.  
 Allegri was sent off at the end of the Roma match over the weekend and will be suspended for the next two fixtures, including tonight’s game and Sunday’s trip to his former club, Juventus.  
 NAPLES, ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Massimiliano Allegri, SSC Napoli head coach, reacts to his expulsion during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images) Napoli will also have to do without the injured Benoit Badiashile and Leonardo Spinazzola, but have welcomed Amir Rrahmani back into the matchday squad.  
 According to pre-match reports, a few changes are in store for Napoli, including a potential start in goal for Vanja Milinkovic-Savic instead of Alex Meret.  
 Kevin De Bruyne is expected to be given a rest in midfield after starting two matches within the last week, while Stanislav Lobotka is likely to return after starting on the bench over the weekend. There could also be an opportunity for Giovane in attack.  
 Monza vs. Napoli: Probable line-ups  
 NAPLES, ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Frank Zambo Anguissa of SSC Napoli celebrates after scoring his sides first goal during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images) Monza (3-4-2-1): Tornqvist; Goglichidze, Luucchesi, Carboni; Birindelli, Akinsanmiro, Foe Ondoa, Mangas; Robinson, Mota; Varela. 
 Napoli (4-3-3): Milinkovic-Savic; Marianucci, Rrahmani, Marin, Olivera; Anguissa, Lobotka, McTominay; Politano, Hojlund, Giovane.  
 Where to watch Monza vs. Napoli 
 MILAN, ITALY – AUGUST 22: Ivan Juric, Head Coach of Monza, reacts during the Serie A match between FC Internazionale and AC Monza at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on August 22, 2026 in Milan, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) Tonight’s game will be available to watch live in the UK on DAZN, on TNT Sports 1 and online through HBO Max. Supporters in the USA are able to tune in via Paramount+.
